exposure: Gestational age at onset of spontaneous labor
outcome: Median gestational age at onset of spontaneous labor
cohort: 12,323 low-risk nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies
finding: 80.5% of spontaneous labor occurred by 41 weeks gestation, and assisted vaginal delivery, caesarean section, and low Apgar scores were significantly more likely with spontaneous labor after 41 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery and caesarean section were significantly more likely with spontaneous labor after 41 weeks gestation.
